description: Behind-the-scenes of how the show is made, off-the-beaten-path splashes, a rescue of an unusual creature, and Kawika's favorite adventures. Plus insights from a UH Hilo student and a treasured Hawaii Island kupuna.

title: It's an Island Thing
description: Ki ho'alu master Kawika Kahiapo joins Lanai and Brook in the studio to talk about his music career, the awards and his passion for cooking.

title: Showcase Hawaii
description: The Manini Reversible Koa Fishhook Necklace offers two designs in one — rich koa wood on one side, a traditional Hawaiian scroll on the reverse. Gold or silver-plated brass with an 18-inch chain, perfect for everyone.

title: The Champ Show
description: Join Champ as he visits local establishments and shows you the products and services they offer, including tasting the cuisine of Hawaii's eateries.

title: Lanai's Travel Club
description: Lanai hits Bangkok, Thailand for bold bites, vibrant culture, fascinating people and sky-high rooftop bars with epic views.

title: Dut's Grindz & Goodtimes
description: Learn what goes into a traditional street dog at the Eastside Kitchen food truck.

title: The Joy of Crafting
description: Brandon Tavares makes a poinsettia from chenille stems; Kristi Ige shows a quick and easy way to start a deco mesh wreath; Joy uses Hearty Clay and paint to create a cute see-through ornament.

title: Upside Down Pilates
description:
Waimea, Part 2
Lisa Orig and her team help people get in shape with exercises that strengthen and tone the entire body.

title: Sports People Hawaii
description: Abraham Tanaka, a golfer in his 90s, shoots his age; Kailua Canoe Club paddlers compete in the Molokai Hoe race to honor the memory of a teammate who passed away just before the event.

title: Cookin' With Cutty
description: Cutty meets a group of kids who give back to their community in very special ways. This inspires everyone to donate to a local charity who provides free meals to those in need. After yoga, kids prepare homemade salad dressing from local ingredients.

title: Ultimate Japan
description: Join the Suzuis as they visit Churaumi Aquarium, one of the biggest aquariums in Japan. See the whale sharks and dolphin show. Join them for a delicious lunch of Okinawa soba and "zenzai", an Okinawan treat. Finally, see the beautiful Kouri Island.

title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
description:
S04 E84
Chef Chris Kajioka of Senia is a James Beard Award nominee. His unique style incorporates techniques from contemporary French cuisine with a distinctly Japanese sensibility. He'll share his recipe for Hirabara Farm Vegetable and Kombu Herb Dip.

title: Fashion Sense by Valerie
description: Valerie styles playful polka dots; Dr. Hanna discusses bone health; Gina shares a side stretch and Denise shares tips to impress homebuyers; pumpkin pie s'mores and a festive cranberry mocktail!

title: Flhi Girlz
description: Check out the 49th Annual North Shore Menehune Surfing Championships in Haleiwa and highlights from the WSL tour events; meet award-winning surf and ocean photographer Christa Funk.
